## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù treats the Mahāyāna doctrine of *Mañjuśrī's Buddha-land* — the eastern Buddha-paradise associated with Mañjuśrī. The text is later incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* as assembly 15 (*Wénshūshīlì shòu jì huì* 文殊師利授記會). Together with [Amoghavajra's later T0319](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0011) it provides two distinct Chinese versions of the same Mahāyāna material.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE). The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The Taishō text (T0318) is established on the standard apparatus.
